player_prompt.intro:
Am ạmi Player {player_id} Connect Four re.
Ạmi ṭikā ṭhākur: {symbol}.
Khel pāṭā {num_rows} ṭhār aur {num_cols} ṭhambha āhāṅ.
Khelār ṭurn ṭurn ṭhambha (0 ṭo {end_col}) re ṭhākur ṭhēlā.
Pahil ṭhākur (ạpan) cār ṭhākur ṭhambha, ṭhār, aur ṭhār-khut re jīt ṭhākur.
Ạmi ṭurn re, ṭhambha ṭhār ṭhēlā ṭhākur ṭhēlā.
Udāharaṇ: '[col 4]' aur '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Ṭhālā ṭhākur ṭhēlā ṭhākur. Ṭhālā ṭhākur ṭhēlā ṭhākur: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Bultai kaj. Column {col} khelai patare bahar-e.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Ṭhālā ṭhākur ṭhēlā ṭhākur. Ṭhambha {col} ṭhēṅgā.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} ᱟᱡᱟᱜ disk ({player_symbol}) ᱮ column {col} ᱨᱮ ᱟᱬᱫᱤ ᱮᱫᱟ.

outcome.win: ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱤᱭᱟᱹ {player_id} ᱫᱚ ᱯᱩᱱᱭᱟᱭ ᱡᱚᱲᱟᱣ ᱠᱟᱛᱮᱜ ᱜᱮᱠᱚ ᱦᱟᱛᱟᱣ ᱮᱫ-ᱟᱭ!
